question: Which of the following states won the Santosh Trophy in Riyadh in March 2023 after a gap of 54 years?
solution:
The correct answer is **Karnataka**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karnataka** won the **Santosh Trophy** in Riyadh in March 2023, marking their victory after a significant gap of 54 years.
 
• This victory is significant as it highlights the development and progress of football in the state of **Karnataka**.
 
• The **Santosh Trophy** is one of the premier football tournaments in India, showcasing the best state teams across the nation.
 
• Winning the trophy after such a long gap demonstrates the hard work, dedication, and talent present in the Karnataka football team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Keyword
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Santosh Trophy**
 Established in 1941, it is one of the oldest football tournaments in India, contested by states and government institutions.
 
 

 **Karnataka**
 A state in the southwestern region of India, known for its contributions to various sports, including cricket, badminton, and now, football.
 
 

 **Riyadh**
 The capital city of Saudi Arabia, showcasing the international venue for the 2023 Santosh Trophy.
 
 

 **Football in India**
 Football is one of the popular sports in India with a rich history and a growing fan base, governed by the All India Football Federation (AIFF).
